description: Revert to the proven 8-layer/128-dim architecture and the stable 2^19 batch size to maximize throughput and convergence speed, as the previous 2^18 batch size likely slowed down the effective learning rate per epoch and reduced the number of updates within the 5-minute budget; slightly reduce the Muon learning rate (0.035 -> 0.034) to ensure stability with the larger batch size.
